<jorkleo> Hi all, quick heads-up for anyone interested in verified reads: colibri, our stateless client that checks consensus and execution proofs on the device, is in Octant's Epoch 13 privacy round, with PAP (Pragmatic Adaptive Privacy), our layer that keeps wallet reads private.

The round closes Wednesday at 8 PM EDT. If light clients and read privacy matter to you, here's our page: https://epoch.octant.app/rounds/0x571ce2d50458a52eabb85e44ffd19151d9acd263ca4cdff491404d635387b77a/project/12

Happy to answer questions about how the verification works.
